app.name: WiiLink Unshackled
app.short_description: Controller support and more for WiiLink's channels
app.long_description: Patches WiiLink's channels where they are installed (NAND, or the SD card as content.bin) with the features you pick: Classic Controller and GameCube controller support, the US clock, a USB keyboard in the Everybody Votes Channel, Message Board photos from the SD card in the Photo Channel and more. Each channel's clean copy is backed up to sd:/wiilink-unshackled/backup first and can be put back at any time.
